title: fix(plugin-security)!: a computed field over a field the caller cannot read is hidden from that caller
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data` (`rules/relationships.md`) teaches a rate as a `formula` over a `summary` and tells an author to mask the summary on a set that must not see it; that instruction is complete as written now, because a formula over the masked summary is withheld with it, so no page needs a new sentence.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:字段级安全现在覆盖计算字段的输入——调用者读不到某字段时,读取该字段(本记录、经另一计算字段、或经引用读取关联记录)的 formula / 存储计算字段对其同样隐藏:记录中不出现、不可作过滤/排序/分组/聚合输入、不列入读/查询投影(含导出表头与元数据 schema)、explain 报告为已屏蔽。
- 为什么改:字段级安全应当覆盖一个值由什么算出;此前计算字段不随其输入一起隐藏。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(BREAKING),只影响被权限集隐藏了某输入字段、却在读其上计算字段的调用者;读不出字段名的表达式在调用者有任一字段被隐藏时整体隐藏(失败即关闭);回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/field-masker.ts`(读集、引用跳读与传递折叠)、`security-plugin-field-readers.ts`(读投影与掩码同一折叠)、`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`(查询守卫与第 4 步接入引用跳读集)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/formula-reads-hidden-field-masking.test.ts`,预期 32 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Field-level security now covers what a field's value is computed from. A caller who cannot read a field — a set marks it `readable: false`, the caller fails its `requiredPermissions`, or it is served under its `maskingRule` — cannot read any computed field (a `formula`, or a stored field declaring an `expression`) whose expression reads that field: on its own record, through another computed field, or on the record it reads through a reference. Every reader of the field map withholds it the same way:

- `find` / `findOne`, a projection, and the record an `insert` / `update` echoes back carry no key for it;
- filtering, sorting, grouping or aggregating by a stored computed field over such a field is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, as by the field it reads (a `formula` is refused in those positions for every caller already);
- the read projection (`getReadableFields`, and every consumer of it: the export header, the object schema the metadata plane serves, the redactions that read it) and the query projection (`getQueryableFields`) leave it out;
- the explain `fls` layer reports it masked from responses;
- where the field it reads is served partially masked, the computed field is withheld whole;
- a computed field whose expression reads the record in a way no field name describes is withheld whenever the caller may not read some other field of the object (fail closed).

One derivation feeds every reader: each object's computed-field reads are taken once, from one parse, into the cached security posture; `foldComputedFieldReads` folds them, transitively, into the field map after the per-field capability fold and the delegator intersection; a computed field reading through a reference is judged by the caller's read projection of the referenced object (one hop, as the engine serves). With the projection folded like the mask, the read projection stays the exact complement of what the read mask deletes, and the query projection still differs from it by exactly the fields served masked, as `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts` states; no spec text moves.

No change to `packages/spec`, to `packages/lint`, or to the metadata-plane schema scrub code.

Files: `field-masker.ts` (reads, reference reads, transitive fold), `security-plugin.ts` (posture fields `computedFieldInputs` and `computedHopTargets`, the reference-read resolver, the projection docblock), `security-plugin-object-inputs.ts` (fold in the result masker and the query guard; the reference-read resolver body), `security-plugin-field-readers.ts` (fold in the read projection; the zero-set posture stand-in), `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` (the reference-read set handed to steps 2.5b, 2.9 and 4; the public-form echo withholds computed fields read through a reference), `explain-engine.ts` and `security-plugin-explain-access.ts` (the `fls` layer), the rule's test file, the two `describe_object` pins and the second-object ledger row named under Acceptance notes, the docs page `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`, one changeset.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/formula-reads-hidden-field-masking.test.ts` — a real `ObjectQL` over a real SQL driver behind the real `SecurityPlugin`; 32 tests named by the rule:

- a formula over a hidden field is absent at `find`, `findOne`, on a projection naming only it, and on the `insert` and `update` echoes;
- the transitive case; the `requiredPermissions` case (and a capability holder's control); a field named only through a function (`label(...)`), with control;
- a field read through a reference: absent when the referenced field is hidden on its own object, absent through a referenced formula, control for a readable referenced field and for a caller who reads it;
- a stored computed field: absent, and refused as a filter, a sort key, a group key and an aggregate input; control that sorting and grouping by a readable field are admitted;
- a partially masked input: the input served masked, the formula absent; control for the unmask capability;
- fail closed end to end for an expression whose reads cannot be named, with control;
- `getReadableFields` and `getQueryableFields` leave the withheld fields out and keep the rest; control for a caller who reads every input;
- explain's `fls` layer names the withheld computed fields;
- a delegated caller: the delegator's hidden field withholds the formula at the result masker; control for a delegator who reads it;
- controls: a caller who reads every input; two sets where one grants the input (union); a system context; a View All holder; the aggregate input gate unchanged;
- the read set: every literal spelling, held equal to the platform member reader (`analyzeRelationshipTraversals`) over every spelling it reads, and the shapes it cannot name.

## Acceptance notes

- Two existing pins moved with the rule, each to a rule-named expectation (no assertion loosened): `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts` held that a stored expression over a field the member cannot read is still served to that member by `describe_object` (expression stripped). Under this rule that field is withheld from the member, so the pin now asserts it is not served, with a control that a caller who reads the input is served it; the stdio twin (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.object-schema-mask.test.ts`) keeps its parity literal with it, its stubbed security answer set to what the real service now answers.
- `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` classifies the new caller of the reference-target arbiter (`computedHopTargetsOf`, `field-masker.ts`) as not a served read: it names the referenced object only to ask the caller's read projection there and withhold; it reads no record of it.
- A computed field reading through a reference is withheld only over a field the referenced object declares and the caller may not read there; a field the referenced object does not declare is answered `null` by the engine, as before.
- No author-time warning names a computed field over a field a set masks; the runtime withholds it either way.
